reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) describes a Ti/Ni coating on diamond in an HEA matrix, not an electroless Ni coating on W in a Cu matrix. It shows that a Ni outer layer can form a solid solution with an HEA matrix and that a Ti inner layer forms carbide, but it provides no direct support for the key premises about W/Cu interfacial energy, interdiffusion, void suppression, or thermal conductivity improvement in W–Cu composites.
